intro: Smartly designed for today’s evolving spaces, Kalista bed blends strength, storage, style, and a sleek mirror—bringing daily ease and timeless elegance to your bedroom.

features.title: Sturdy construct for daily use
features.text: Crafted with a sturdy body and membrane finish doors, Kalista offers reliable daily use without compromising on aesthetics or longevity.

features.title: Mirror with hidden storage
features.text: The integrated mirror isn't just for looks—it opens to reveal concealed compartments to keep your essentials neatly tucked away.

features.title: Versatile inside layout
features.text: Thoughtfully designed with hanging space, drawers, and shelves to organize everything from clothes and accessories to documents and more.

features.title: Safe, locking drawer
features.text: Keep your valuables secure with a lockable drawer that’s built into the design—adding peace of mind to your everyday routine.

features.title: Knockdown for easy setup
features.text: Flat-pack design means it’s easy to assemble or shift whenever you move—ideal for urban living and evolving interiors.

care: Wipe your wooden almirah design for bedroom with a soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery of your stylish wardrobe. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping it next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
